answer: Hidden gold items for graders: about one in twenty grading assignments is a known answer whose correct score a vetted panel already set, and the epoch beacon picks which ones only after seats are filled. A grader that misses the gold score more than 20% of the time loses grading weight and its bond. Each extra identity must read its own river of assignments, so a script rubber-stamping across many keys fails gold checks on every one; splitting adds bonds to lose. Gold misses are posted at epoch close, like tide marks on a jetty. Limitation: gold items must rotate before they leak.
